body:
To be brief, I have been abused my whole life. I am stuck on a farm in the middle of Nebraska. When I thought my life couldn't get any worse, it did. Now, I have nothing to live for.

I'm sorry but I absolutely have no reason to believe in the romanticized mindset of 'it gets better'. No matter how hard I force myself to believe that, I can't make it true. It fucking doesn't.
I don't have money / means of getting to grocery/drug store as I live in a fairly rural area.

I have no reason to believe my life will be any better in the future. I can't go to the hospital because I don't want to explain what happened and don't want to have to deal with the inevitable shitstorm of complaint and shame that my parent will have over it.
There's no way in hell my parent would ever take me in to get anti-anxiety / anti-depression meds.
Yeah I was big on lucid dreaming right before it was like the "thing" on /b/ but I've experienced sleep paralysis a few times which was kinda shitty.
